meta.query_interpretation: Interpreted as a geographic question, grouped by country, rendered as a geo bar chart.
assumptions: Interpreted 'most' as a geographic breakdown of recruiting trials by country.
warnings: Trials can belong to more than one bucket on this axis (for example a combined Phase 1/2 trial), so bucket totals may sum to more than the number of trials.
